clarification: this addendum governs strict baseline/cache and exact scoring/loss semantics; first FP16 storage estimate is retained, not overwritten; no experiments follow either design in this audit

strict_baseline.primary_cache_dtype: float32 lossless native BEV, no compression quantization
strict_baseline.FP16: storage alternative only, not primary formal baseline; requires separate registered quantization analysis, no silent adoption
strict_baseline.parity: >=3 consecutive raw TRAIN frames: full original forward vs FP32 BEV full-Head replay cls/bbox/seg bitwise equal, including current native temporal history; fail closed otherwise
strict_baseline.raw_pipeline: deterministic author test transform, no PhotoMetricDistortion; eval state; native scene chronology/history preserved
strict_baseline.unchanged: original checkpoint, all native parameters/buffers, cropper, decoder, text encoder; no enhanced feature into native temporal history

grounding_contract.warmup_probe: 128 train frames chosen by token hash before training, positive-only IoU macro across map/object spaces; empty active fraction separate; no dev labels
grounding_contract.bce: per-example valid positives and negatives balanced; positives/empty examples separately averaged; no positive Dice for empty target
grounding_contract.ranking: for paired actual texts c,w with independently grounded target sets S_c,S_w: mean relu(0.5-logit_c+logit_w) on S_c minus S_w, and symmetric term on S_w minus S_c; skip empty set, never mark all wrong-text foreground as negative
grounding_contract.overlap: do not rank shared target pixels; different instruction IDs are insufficient unless grounded target sets differ
grounding_contract.gt_input_policy: target sets used in loss/scorer only, never adapter/native model inputs; position only calibration-derived
grounding_contract.full_labels: all train frames retained including6 actual emptyGT; record per-frame valid task, failed associations and out-of-map cells, cannot silently drop/reassign frames or recompute budget

scoring_contract.query_unit: virtual sample=(frame token, fixed instruction ID), never claim repeated prompts as new independent frames
scoring_contract.related_gt: all/nearest/farthest exact annotation IDs per frozen instruction table; predicted boxes filtered only by requested class, not GT proximity; sameclass distractor boxes count FP, other classes ignored for related metric
scoring_contract.ap: SDK recall grid/min_recall0.1/min_precision0.1 and score sorting; equal mean over2classes x4distances; empty-target instructions retain all sameclass predictions as FP; absent positive class makes gate NOT_EVALUABLE, not zero
scoring_contract.related_seg_roi: GT selected-record raster dilated by Euclidean pixel-centre distance<=2m, fixed0.15m raster; fullGT labels in ROI, never replace other true sameclass instances by background
scoring_contract.related_seg_macro: pool intersection/union within each class over frozen positive queries then average2class IoUs; empty map queries reported separately, never inflate positive mIoU
scoring_contract.overall: one hash-selected canonical prompt per frame, full10class detection4distance and3foreground semantic macroIoU; no ROI filtering
scoring_contract.wrong_zero: use same correct-query GT to score all4branches; wrong text has separate GT only during paired training, never change evaluation target
scoring_contract.statistical_unit: drive scene for1000 seeded bootstrap replicates, not language prompt; disclose same-location overlap may persist across logs
scoring_contract.target: absolute+2.0pp related conditionalmAP,+1.5pp related macroIoU; overall mAP/mIoU decrease<=2.0pp; correct must exceed wrong/zero on both related metrics; no claim official project acceptance without aligned benchmark scope

remaining_gates.current16step_runner: incompatible full data indices/mini dataset; not a formal training command

long_training_command: NONE: formal full-data trainer/scorer/cache/label pipeline must be implemented and validated in a later explicitly scheduled run
